capabilities.simd: Supported compiler feature, not measured by these scalar integer cases; automatic vectorization is allowed and must be audited in final code.
capabilities.matmul_layout: 64x64 flattened row-major ordinary integer triple loop; no transposition or BLAS.
capabilities.allocation: Ordinary Box.new/drop versus ordinary malloc/free. No optimization barriers; final allocation elision must be reported separately from allocator throughput.
capabilities.dispatch: Concrete, generic-bound static and borrowed dyn interface variants. Optimizers may devirtualize; final indirect calls must be audited rather than presumed.
capabilities.generic: array_reduce and generic_helpers have identical arithmetic; only identity helper is non-generic versus generic. C has no generic language mechanism and uses the same specialized helper.
capabilities.slice_adapter: The borrowed Slice/pointer-length view is created inside the kernel in both languages. A live Aevix loan cannot cross an ownership-opaque FFI clock call. This small view construction is included in the Slice case.
capabilities.thread_pool: Not implemented as a reusable persistent pool; no pool timing case.
capabilities.jit_tiering: Current ORC eager optimized execution; no actual hotness-driven tier/recompilation benchmark.
capabilities.timing_scope: Kernel call only, initialization and full exact-result output outside two scalar FFI clock calls; no startup/JIT-compile timing claim.
